meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会读取你提供的文本，按 12 个认知维度逐项打分，再生成认知画像报告：包含主导模式、阴影模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹、关键引文和一段综合描述。它只描述思维风格，不评判好坏。
howto.when: 当你想分析某个人怎么思考、比较多个人的思维风格、问“我的思维风格是什么”，或提供文本想了解作者推理与决策方式时，Claude 会触发这项技能。

say.text: 分析这段话作者的思维风格。
say.note: Claude 会给出 12 维打分和认知画像。

say.text: 对比这两个人写的文本，看看思维差异。
say.note: 进入比较模式，输出各自画像与异同点。

say.text: 用我们的对话记录给我做一份自我思维画像。
say.note: 会说明对话文本的局限，可再提供其他样本重测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the provided text, scores it across 12 cognitive dimensions, and produces a cognitive profile report: dominant and shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, key quotes, and a narrative synthesis. It describes thinking style without judging it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to analyze someone's thinking, compare thinking styles, ask about your own style, or provide text for insight into the author's reasoning and decision style.

say_en.text: Analyze the thinking style of this text's author.
Compare how these two people think based on their writing.
say_en.note: Runs comparison mode with profiles and differences.

say_en.text: Create a self-profile from our conversation.
say_en.note: Notes limitations of chat text and can re-profile with other samples.
